messages:
elaine: Heads-up: small coordinated rollout during 01:30-03:30 UTC. Deploybot will pin in this order: api -> runtime -> router -> console. Versions: api@1.14.2 runtime@2.4.1 router@3.9.0 console@4.1.0. Putting a short watch; please call out any preflight concerns.

deploybot: Deploybot: preflight ok at 01:10 UTC. Will execute pins with 6s spacing and emit step events. Canaries supported per service.

peter: Runtime note: we'll warmup via /ops/warmup for primary shard-set, then ramp 5% traffic for 7m. I'll prime KV prefixes session/* and ctx/* before traffic shift. Starting warmup at 01:22.

sasha: Rollback criteria reminder: sustained error rate >0.35% for 5m OR p99 latency >1000ms. Prefer partial rollback strategy: unpin router and console first to reduce user-facing surface, then api/runtime if needed. @oncall_mike can you confirm unpin perms?

oncall_mike: I have perms. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/deploy-rollback. Quick commands attached below. Will mute noisy alerts on action.

oncall_mike: ```
# quick unpin example
curl -X POST "https://ops.internal/release/unpin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"service":"router","version":"3.9.0"}'
# then console
curl -X POST "https://ops.internal/release/unpin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"service":"console","version":"4.1.0"}'
```

elaine: Note: console includes a background migration flagged as non-blocking but we should still watch DB replica lag. Also logging config changes might create brief spikes.

deploybot: Starting sequence: api pinned -> runtime pending -> router queued -> console queued. Event refs: rseq_20260323_a1.

peter: Warmup started at 01:22. Warmup endpoints returning 200 across 6 shards. Beginning canary shift at 01:30: 5% traffic to runtime-canary.

sasha: Canary watch plan: pods and infra channel for 10m, screenshots at +2m, +6m. If alerts exceed threshold call rollback.

oncall_mike: If I trigger an unpin I'll: 1) mute alert policies for 3m 2) run unpin commands 3) create incident ticket and tag #incidents 4) annotate timeline in this thread.

peter: Canary +4m: error rate 0.02%, p99 +8ms. KV priming succeeded. No eviction warnings.

deploybot: runtime pinned -> router pending -> console pending.

elaine: Quick note for release notes: mention ordering and rollback steps + runbook link. Also include the console feature flag id FF-2026 if we need fast-toggle.

sasha: If we hit transient noise but metrics return to baseline within 3m, prefer to let canary stabilize rather than immediate rollback (unless thresholds crossed). Documented in the runbook.

oncall_mike: All set here. I'll be on-call for next 45m and will run unpin if needed.

deploybot: api -> runtime -> router -> console all pinned. Smoke tests running.

peter: Smoke ok at 01:46. No user-facing errors observed. Closing the watch in 15m unless anyone objects.

elaine: Closing notes: updated release notes with pin order, rollback commands, and monitoring links. Thanks team :party_popper:
